input.sha256_scope: No input pixels are committed. This is a digest over the four per-record `source_rgb_sha256` values, concatenated in record order; each case is a deterministic synthetic image from the closed form (x*7 + y*13 + c*29) % 256, reproduced identically in the capture tool and the Rust test.

upstream.capture_method: The pinned PaddleX operators were imported and executed, not transcribed. That is what exposed two bugs in the layout capture this shares a code path with.

artifact_provenance.weights_used: None. No model was run: this fixture covers preprocessing only, and the two artifacts' configs agree on every field it reads.

limitations: No model is run, so this pins preprocessing and says nothing about detection quality.

One case -- table_crop_297x421 -- inherits the cubic resize's open divergence and is bounded rather than matched exactly. The full-tensor measurement is 10 differing bytes of 1,228,800; the other three cases are exact.
`artifacts` is null on purpose: the repository gate reserves that field for reviewed end-to-end fixtures that load a model, and this fixture loads none.
